payload.body: Implemented agent protocol 1.0 across CLI, Node, REST, MCP, SQLite, sync, and Postgres: crash-safe event transactions; capability discovery and stable envelopes; request/revision fencing; readiness, leases, attempts, contracts, policies, repository intent, context, discoveries, plans, conflicts, metrics, watch; generated docs and non-skipping Postgres CI. Verified 398/398 tests with Postgres and RLS enabled.
